data.one_liner: Extension to capitalize strings and list items.
data.what_it_does: Provides methods to capitalize the first letter of a string, each word in a string, and each item in a list of strings. It also includes a startsWithCapital check.
use_when: Need to capitalize the first letter of a word
Need title‑case conversion for a string
Need to capitalize each element of a List<String>
avoid_when: Need to manipulate strings beyond simple capitalization
weaknesses: Limited to basic capitalization, no locale support
